# Blazor AI Chat — Download Files Generated by an AI Assistant

AI assistants can generate files in response to user messages. In such instances, AI assistant responses may contain links/annotations associated with the generated file(s). This example pre-processes such messages to display custom links routed to an ASP.NET Core minimal API endpoint. When a user clicks a link, the endpoint downloads the requested file from [OpenAI](https://openai.com/) and returns it to the browser.

> [!NOTE]  
> DevExpress AI-powered extensions operate on a "bring your own key" (BYOK) model. DevExpress does not offer a proprietary REST API or bundled language models (LLMs/SLMs).
>
> You can either deploy a self-hosted model or connect to a cloud AI provider and obtain necessary connection parameters (such as endpoint, API key, language model identifier). Configure these parameters at application startup to register an AI client and enable extension functionality.

> [!WARNING]
> This example demonstrates the minimum configuration required to download AI-generated files. As such, the API endpoint does not check authentication or authorization.
>
> In a real application, secure the endpoint against potentially malicious requests. For example, you can add authorization as described in the [Microsoft documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/fundamentals/minimal-apis/security?view=aspnetcore-10.0#configure-authorization-policies-in-minimal-apps) and implement custom resource-based access to ensure users can only download files that they generated themselves.

## Implementation Details

1. Connect the [DevExpress Blazor AI Chat](https://docs.devexpress.com/Blazor/405290/ai-powered-extensions/ai-chat-component/ai-chat) component to the [OpenAI](https://openai.com/) provider:
    - Install the NuGet packages listed in the following help topic: [Manual AI Services Integration - OpenAI](https://docs.devexpress.com/Blazor/405228/ai-powered-extensions#openai).
    - Install [Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI) and [DevExpress.AIIntegration.Agents](https://www.nuget.org/packages/DevExpress.AIIntegration.Agents) packages to enable AI agent integration.
    - Specify your OpenAI API key and model name in the `OpenAISettings` section of the `appsettings.json` file (`Key` and `DeploymentName` settings). If your code omits these settings, the application throws an exception at startup.

2. Use [`HostedCodeInterpreterTool`](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.ai.hostedcodeinterpretertool) to allow the OpenAI Agent to generate files:

    ```cs
    AIAgent agent = openAIClient.GetResponsesClient().AsAIAgent(
        model: openAiServiceSettings.DeploymentName,
        instructions: "You are a helpful assistant that can generate files using code.",
        name: "CodeInterpreterAgent",
        tools: [new HostedCodeInterpreterTool()]
    );
    builder.Services.AddSingleton(agent.AsIChatResponseProvider());
    ```
> [!NOTE]  
> Multiple OpenAI .NET SDK APIs used in this example are marked as experimental. To compile the associated code, suppress the `OPENAI001` diagnostic (for example, run `#pragma warning disable OPENAI001`).

3. Define a [`MessageContentTemplate`](https://docs.devexpress.com/Blazor/DevExpress.AIIntegration.Blazor.Chat.DxAIChat.MessageContentTemplate) for `DxAIChat` and process file links in the message as follows (see [Index.razor](./AIChatDownloadFiles/Components/Pages/Index.razor)):

    * **Find file annotations.** Iterate through the message's [`Contents`](https://docs.devexpress.com/Blazor/DevExpress.AIIntegration.Blazor.Chat.BlazorChatMessage.Contents) collection and check the `Annotations` collection of each content item. OpenAI file links are `CitationAnnotation` objects. Each object's `RawRepresentation` property returns a `ContainerFileCitationMessageAnnotation` object.
    * **Build download URLs.** `ContainerId` and `FileId` uniquely identify the file. Use them as URL route parameters for the `downloads` path. Build a URL in the following format: `downloads/{ContainerId}/{FileId}?filename={Filename}`. Note that `Filename` must be URL-encoded.
    * **Replace original links.** `StartIndex` and `EndIndex` specify the original link position in the [message text](https://docs.devexpress.com/Blazor/DevExpress.AIIntegration.Blazor.Chat.BlazorChatMessage.Text). Replace this text range with the new URL. Process annotations from the last to first to ensure that each replacement does not shift the positions of the remaining links.
    * **Render sanitized HTML.** Use a third-party processor to convert Markdown text to HTML and sanitize the result. This example uses [Markdig](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Markdig/) and [HtmlSanitizer](https://www.nuget.org/packages/HtmlSanitizer/).

4. Define a minimal API endpoint that handles requests to the "downloads" path. Validate `containerId` and `fileId` route parameters and the `filename` query parameter. Pass the IDs to the OpenAI Containers API to download the file.

    ```cs
    public static partial class RegexHelper {
        [GeneratedRegex(@"^cntr_[a-z0-9]+$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
        public static partial Regex ContainerIdRegex();

        [GeneratedRegex(@"^cfile_[a-z0-9]+$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
        public static partial Regex FileIdRegex();
    }
    ```

    ```cs
    app.MapGet("/downloads/{containerId}/{fileId}", async (string containerId, string fileId, [FromQuery] string filename) => {
        if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(containerId) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileId) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filename)
            || containerId.Length > 128 || fileId.Length > 128 || filename.Length > 260) {
            return Results.BadRequest();
        }

        if(!(RegexHelper.ContainerIdRegex().IsMatch(containerId) && RegexHelper.FileIdRegex().IsMatch(fileId) && filename.IndexOfAny(Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars()) < 0)) {
            return Results.BadRequest();
        }

        try {
            BinaryData fileData = await openAIClient.GetContainerClient().DownloadContainerFileAsync(
                containerId,
                fileId);
            var contentType = "application/octet-stream";
            return Results.File(fileData.ToArray(), contentType, filename);
        }
        catch(ClientResultException clientEx) when(clientEx.Status == 404) {
            return Results.NotFound();
        }
        catch {
            return Results.StatusCode(500);
        }
    });
    ```
